# Third-party code

Vendored single-header libraries, unmodified.

| File | Project | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stb_image.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | 2.30 | MIT or public domain |
| `stb_image_write.h` | https://github.com/nothings/stb | 1.16 | MIT or public domain |
| `tiny_obj_loader.h` | https://github.com/tinyobjloader/tinyobjloader (release branch) | 2.0.0 | MIT |
| `doctest.h` | https://github.com/doctest/doctest | 2.4.12 | MIT |

SDL2 is not vendored; it comes from Homebrew (`brew install sdl2`, which installs sdl2-compat on top of SDL3). zlib license.
